result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but the bottom navigation bar appears visually broken: a stray thick horizontal line runs through the search and orders icons, and the nav icons themselves look vertically clipped, cutting off their bottoms.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar/line stretches across the bottom navigation between the search icon and the orders (receipt) icon, overlapping both icons. It looks like a rendering artifact or misplaced element (e.g., an iOS home-indicator bar or divider rendered in the wrong position), making the tab bar look broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar element; if it is the system home indicator, ensure the tab bar accounts for safe-area insets so it doesn't overlap the icons.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders, profile) are vertically clipped — the lower portions of the icons are cut off, and there is no visible padding or labels beneath them.
issues.suggestion: Increase the tab bar height and add bottom safe-area padding so all icons (and any labels) render fully within the navigation bar.
